/*********************************************************************/
/* Type definition for the TLSA0100 format of the receiver variable. */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef _Packed struct QsoRtvTLSA_TLSA0100                   /* @A1C */
{
  unsigned short supportedProtocolList[10];  /*  Supported protocols */
  unsigned supportedProtocolCount;  /* Number of supported protocols */
  unsigned short eligibleDefaultProtocolList[10];/*  Elig def protos */
  unsigned eligibleDefaultProtocolCount;   /* Number elig def protos */
  unsigned short defaultProtocolList[10];    /*    Default protocols */
  unsigned defaultProtocolCount;      /* Number of default protocols */

  unsigned short supportedCipherList[64]; /* Supported cipher suites */
  unsigned supportedCipherCount;/* Number of supported cipher suites */
  unsigned short eligibleDefaultCipherList[64];  /* Elig def ciphers */
  unsigned eligibleDefaultCipherCount;    /* Number elig def ciphers */
  unsigned short defaultCipherList[64];     /* Default cipher suites */
  unsigned defaultCipherCount;    /* Number of default cipher suites */

  unsigned short supportedSigAlgList[32];  /* Supported sig alg list */
  unsigned supportedSigAlgCount;     /* Number of supported sig algs */
  unsigned short defaultSigAlgList[32];      /* Default sig alg list */
  unsigned defaultSigAlgCount;        /*  Number of default sig algs */

  unsigned short supportedSigAlgCertList[32];/* Sup sig alg cert list */
  unsigned supportedSigAlgCertCount;   /* Number of sup sig alg certs */
  unsigned short defaultSigAlgCertList[32];  /* Def sig alg cert list */
  unsigned defaultSigAlgCertCount; /* Number of default sig alg certs */

  unsigned short supportedNamedCurveList[32];/*Supported named curves */
  unsigned supportedNamedCurveCount; /* Number supported named curves */
  unsigned short defaultNamedCurveList[32];  /*  Default named curves */
  unsigned defaultNamedCurveCount;  /* Number of default named curves */

  unsigned minimumRsaKeySize;    /* Default minimum RSA key size      */
  unsigned tlsRenegotiationType; /* TLS renegotiation without RFC5746 */
  unsigned sslV2HSCount;         /* SSLv2 handshake connection count  */
  unsigned sslV3HSCount;  	 /* SSLv3 handshake connection count  */
  unsigned tlsV10HSCount; 	 /* TLSv10 handshake connection count */
  unsigned tlsV11HSCount; 	 /* TLSv11 handshake connection count */
  unsigned tlsV12HSCount; 	 /* TLSv12 handshake connection count */
  unsigned tlsV13HSCount; 	 /* TLSv13 handshake connection count */
  unsigned ocspCertRevocation;/* OCSP certificate revocation check @A2A */
  unsigned reserved1[16];        /* Reserved                     @A2C */

  int  enableHandshakeCount :1;  /* Handshake counting enabled        */
  int  secureSessionCaching :1;     /* Secure session caching enabled */
  int  rfc5746RequiredClient :1; /* RFC5746 client required flag      */
  int  rfc5746RequiredServer :1; /* RFC5746 server required flag      */
  int  rfc7366EtMClient :1;  /* RFC7366 client hello supported flag   */
  int  rfc7366EtMRequired :1;       /* RFC7366 required flag          */
  int  rfc7627EMSClient :1;  /* RFC7627 client hello supported flag   */
  int  rfc7627EMSRequired :1;       /* RFC7627 required flag          */
  int  middleboxCompatibilityMode:1; /* Middlebox compatibility mode  */
  int  netsecureTelnetServer :1;    /* Audit secure telnet handshakes */
  int  reserved2 : 22;           /* Reserved                          */
  char pad[12];                  /* Padding (ignored)                 */

} QsoRtvTLSA_TLSA0100_t;                                     /* @A1C */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Type definition for the TLSA0200 format of the receiver variable. */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef _Packed struct QsoRtvTLSA_TLSA0200                   /* @A2A */
{
  unsigned enableHandshakeCount; /* Handshake counting enabled        */
  unsigned sslV2HSCount;         /* SSLv2 handshake connection count  */
  unsigned sslV3HSCount;  	 /* SSLv3 handshake connection count  */
  unsigned tlsV10HSCount; 	 /* TLSv10 handshake connection count */
  unsigned tlsV11HSCount; 	 /* TLSv11 handshake connection count */
  unsigned tlsV12HSCount; 	 /* TLSv12 handshake connection count */
  unsigned tlsV13HSCount; 	 /* TLSv13 handshake connection count */
  unsigned reserved1[5];         /* Reserved                          */
                          /* Cipher suite handshake connection counts */
  unsigned aes128GcmSha256Cnt;                 /* *AES_128_GCM_SHA256 */
  unsigned aes256GcmSha384Cnt;                 /* *AES_256_GCM_SHA384 */
  unsigned chaCha20P1305Cnt;             /* *CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsaAes128GcmSha256Cnt;
                              /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsaAes256GcmSha384Cnt;
                              /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsaChaCha20P1305Cnt;
                        /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 */
  unsigned ecdheRsaAes128GcmSha256Cnt;
	                        /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 */
  unsigned ecdheRsaAes256GcmSha384Cnt;
                                /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 */
  unsigned ecdheRsaChaCha20P1305Cnt;
                          /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 */
  unsigned rsaAes128GcmSha256Cnt;
                                      /* *RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 */
  unsigned rsaAes256GcmSha384Cnt;
                                      /* *RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsaAes128CbcSha256Cnt;
                              /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256 */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsaAes256CbcSha384Cnt;
                              /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384 */
  unsigned ecdheRsaAes128CbcSha256Cnt;
                                /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256 */
  unsigned ecdheRsaAes256CbcSha384Cnt;
                                /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384 */
  unsigned rsaAes128CbcSha256Cnt;
                                      /* *RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256 */
  unsigned rsaAes128CbcShaCnt;           /* *RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA */
  unsigned rsaAes256CbcSha256Cnt;
                                      /* *RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256 */
  unsigned rsaAes256CbcShaCnt;           /* *RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsa3DesEdeCbcShaCnt;
                                /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA */
  unsigned ecdheRsa3DesEdeCbcShaCnt;
                                  /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA */
  unsigned rsa3DesEdeCbcShaCnt;         /* *RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsaRc4128ShaCnt;
                                     /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA */
  unsigned ecdheRsaRc4128ShaCnt;       /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA */
  unsigned rsaRc4128ShaCnt;                  /* *RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA */
  unsigned rsaRc4128Md5Cnt;                  /* *RSA_WITH_RC4_128_MD5 */
  unsigned rsaDesCbcShaCnt;                  /* *RSA_WITH_DES_CBC_SHA */
  unsigned rsaExportRc440Md5Cnt;       /* *RSA_EXPORT_WITH_RC4_40_MD5 */
  unsigned rsaExportRc2Cbc40Md5Cnt;
                                   /* *RSA_EXPORT_WITH_RC2_CBC_40_MD5 */
  unsigned ecdheEcdsaNullShaCnt;        /* *ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_NULL_SHA */
  unsigned ecdheRsaNullShaCnt;            /* *ECDHE_RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA */
  unsigned rsaNullSha256Cnt;                 /* *RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA256 */
  unsigned rsaNullShaCnt;                       /* *RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA */
  unsigned rsaNullMd5Cnt;                       /* *RSA_WITH_NULL_MD5 */
  unsigned rsa3DesEdeCbcMd5Cnt;         /* *RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_MD5 */
  unsigned rsaDesCbcMd5Cnt;                  /* *RSA_WITH_DES_CBC_MD5 */
  unsigned rsaRc2Cbc128Md5Cnt;           /* *RSA_WITH_RC2_CBC_128_MD5 */
  unsigned reserved2[27];        /* Reserved                          */

} QsoRtvTLSA_TLSA0200_t;

/*********************************************************************/
/* Function prototypes                                               */
/*********************************************************************/

QSO_EXTERN void QsoRtvTLSA(char *, char *, int *, char *);

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for returned attribute values from QsoRtvTLSA              */
/*********************************************************************/
/* The following TLS/SSL protocol values may be returned */
#define TLSA_SSLV2_PROTOCOL                      0x0002
#define TLSA_SSLV3_PROTOCOL                      0x0300
#define TLSA_TLSV10_PROTOCOL                     0x0301
#define TLSA_TLSV11_PROTOCOL                     0x0302
#define TLSA_TLSV12_PROTOCOL                     0x0303
#define TLSA_TLSV13_PROTOCOL                     0x0304

/* The following TLS cipher suite values may be returned */
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_NULL_MD5                         0x0001
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA                         0x0002
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA256                      0x003B
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA                      0x0005
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_DES_CBC_SHA                      0x0009
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA                 0x000A

#define TLSA_RSA_EXPORT_WITH_RC4_40_MD5                0x0003
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_MD5                      0x0004
#define TLSA_RSA_EXPORT_WITH_RC2_CBC_40_MD5            0x0006

#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_RC2_CBC_128_MD5                  0xFF01
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_DES_CBC_MD5                      0xFF02
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_MD5                 0xFF03

#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA                  0x002F
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA                  0x0035
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256               0x003C
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256               0x003D

#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256               0x009C
#define TLSA_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384               0x009D
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_NULL_SHA                 0xC006
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA              0xC007
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA         0xC008
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA                   0xC010
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA                0xC011
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA           0xC012
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256       0xC023
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384       0xC024
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256         0xC027
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384         0xC028
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256       0xC02B
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384       0xC02C
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256         0xC02F
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384         0xC030
#define TLSA_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256   0xCCA8  /* @A2A */
#define TLSA_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 0xCCA9  /* @A2A */
#define TLSA_AES_128_GCM_SHA256                        0x1301
#define TLSA_AES_256_GCM_SHA384                        0x1302
#define TLSA_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256                  0x1303

/* The following TLS signature algorithm values may be returned */
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_MD5                     0x0101
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_SHA1                    0x0201
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_SHA224                  0x0301
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_SHA256                  0x0401
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_SHA384                  0x0501
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_SHA512                  0x0601
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_ECDSA_SHA1                  0x0203
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_ECDSA_SHA224                0x0303
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_ECDSA_SHA256                0x0403
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_ECDSA_SHA384                0x0503
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_ECDSA_SHA512                0x0603
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_PSS_SHA256              0x0804
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_PSS_SHA384              0x0805
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_RSA_PSS_SHA512              0x0806
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_ED25519                     0x0807
#define TLSA_SIG_ALG_ED448                       0x0808

/* The following TLS elliptical curve named curve values may be returned */
#define TLSA_CURVE_SECP192R1                     0x0013
#define TLSA_CURVE_SECP224R1                     0x0015
#define TLSA_CURVE_SECP256R1                     0x0017
#define TLSA_CURVE_SECP384R1                     0x0018
#define TLSA_CURVE_SECP521R1                     0x0019
#define TLSA_CURVE_X25519                        0x001D
#define TLSA_CURVE_X448                          0x001E

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)
#pragma datamodel(pop)
#endif
